name: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope
tagline: Wide-field infrared survey of the dark universe, launched August 2026
description: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is NASA's wide-field infrared survey telescope, built to explore the dark universe, including dark matter. It has a 2.4 m primary mirror, a 300-megapixel Wide Field Instrument and a Coronagraph Instrument that tests technology for imaging planets, and it is 12.7 m long. NASA Goddard leads the project, with BAE Systems, L3Harris and Teledyne as builders and contributions from ESA, JAXA, CNES and Max Planck. It launched on 2026-08-30 at 11:26 UTC on a Falcon Heavy from pad 39A at Kennedy Space Center. It is making a three-month journey to a large looping orbit around the Sun-Earth L2 point, with arrival expected in early December 2026, and its first science images are expected in early 2027. The prime mission is five years, extendable by five.
best_known_for: NASA's wide-field infrared survey telescope: launched in August 2026, on its way to L2
